description: Search NHTSA defect investigations — Preliminary Evaluations (PE), Engineering Analyses (EA), Defect Petitions (DP), Recall Queries (RQ), Audit Queries (AQ), and additional ODI types — newest-opened first. make, model, and modelYear match the investigation's vehicle associations, all on the same association; component matches its affected components. All filters are ANDed. Search rows leave out the full summary unless includeSummary is true. Use nhtsaId to fetch one investigation by its exact ID with its full summary — including the investigationId nhtsa_search_recalls returns for a campaign. recallCampaigns lists the recall campaigns NHTSA links to an investigation; pass any to nhtsa_search_recalls as campaignNumber.

closeDateRange.description: Inclusive closed-date bounds in calendar-valid YYYY-MM-DD. Active bounds exclude investigations without a usable close date, including open investigations.

after.description: Inclusive lower bound, a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD. Blank means unset.

before.description: Inclusive upper bound, a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD. Blank means unset.

component.description: Structured filter — matches against the investigation's affected components (e.g., "STEERING"). ANDed with other filters.

includeSummary.description: Include each investigation's full summary in search rows. Off by default: rows carry the subject, dates, vehicle associations, and campaign links, and nhtsaId mode always returns the summary. A summary can run several thousand characters, so pair this with a small limit.

investigationType.description: Filter by ODI investigation type code (the leading letters of the NHTSA ID). Named types: "PE" (Preliminary Evaluation), "EA" (Engineering Analysis), "DP" (Defect Petition), "RQ" (Recall Query), "AQ" (Audit Query). Additional valid codes present in the dataset: "SQ", "EQ", "RP", "ID", "TA", "C". Pass any code exactly as it appears in the investigation ID prefix.

limit.description: Investigations per page. Defaults to 20; at most 50 per page.

make.description: Vehicle make on one of the investigation's vehicle associations (e.g., "TOYOTA"), matched case-insensitively within the name. With model or modelYear, all must match the same association.

model.description: Vehicle model on one of the investigation's vehicle associations, matched case-insensitively within the name. With make or modelYear, all must match the same association.

modelYear.description: Model year, a whole number. Matches when one vehicle association carries this year together with every supplied make and model; an investigation with no model year on any association never matches.

nhtsaId.description: Exact NHTSA investigation ID (e.g. "EA23003"), case-insensitive. Fetches that one record with its full summary — mutually exclusive with every other filter.

offset.description: Pagination offset into the matching investigations, ordered newest-opened first: open date descending, then ID descending, undated last. Defaults to 0.

openDateRange.description: Inclusive opened-date bounds in calendar-valid YYYY-MM-DD. ANDed with other filters; blank bounds are unset.

after.description: Inclusive lower bound, a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD. Blank means unset.

before.description: Inclusive upper bound, a calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD. Blank means unset.

query.description: Free-text search across investigation ID, subject, and summary.

status.description: Filter by status: "O" (Open) or "C" (Closed). Omit to include both.

name: nhtsa_search_investigations

effectiveQuery.description: Applied filters as a readable string, e.g. make="Ford", status="O".

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `mode_conflict`: nhtsaId was combined with another filter. `invalid_date`: A date bound is not a calendar-valid YYYY-MM-DD date. `inverted_date_range`: A range has after later than before. `limit_too_large`: limit exceeds the 50-row page maximum on a server set to reject an over-maximum limit rather than lower it. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

manufacturers.description: Manufacturers named on the investigation's vehicle associations

recallCampaigns.description: Recall campaigns linked to the investigation, as NHTSA lists them — pass any to nhtsa_search_recalls as campaignNumber

summary.description: Investigation summary. Present in nhtsaId mode, and in search rows only with includeSummary: true.

years.description: Model years across all of the investigation's vehicle associations, every make and model, ascending

limit.description: Pagination limit used for this page

notice.description: Guidance when no investigations match the filters, when the requested page overshoots the result set, when limit was lowered to the page maximum, or when search rows omit summaries.

offset.description: Pagination offset used for this page

returned.description: Number of investigations in this page

title: Nhtsa Search Investigations
